overload_type_resolution.description: Numeric scalar, array or recursively numeric cluster. F32/F64 and C32/C64 are supported; integer leaves convert to F64 before calculation and values above 2^53 may round. Arrays preserve rank and clusters preserve ordered field identities. Binary operands require matching aggregate structures and actual array dimensions; one whole scalar operand may lift through the other aggregate. No fixed-point, extended precision, dimensional broadcasting. Real invalid-domain results follow IEEE NaN/Infinity; non-finite complex results are explicitly unsupported. Concrete matrix<f64> dispatch is separate from element-wise Array/Cluster lifting: nonempty square matrices of dimension at most 32; finite real output only, bounded arithmetic and numerical residual checks. Exponential uses matrix Pade scaling/squaring; Natural Logarithm uses the convergent real principal matrix logarithm; Power uses actual matrix products for integer exponents and Exp(y*Ln(A)) for admissible noninteger real exponents. Complex branch-cut, ill-conditioned, nonconvergent or overflowing Matrix results fail explicitly.
